allocation: $100 long spot + $100 isolated short-perpetual margin + $50 reserve
leverage: 1x futures notional/margin; BTC is never traded
decision_rule: At 00:01 UTC on the first day of each month, rank the completed prior-month funding sum. Enter the leader at >=10 bps; exit the held asset at <=0 bps; switch only after a full round-trip cost hurdle.
causality: Every decision uses funding observations strictly before that UTC month.
limitations: Perpetual minute price is a proxy for both spot and funding mark price.
Spot/perpetual basis, transfer delays, outages, taxes and liquidation-engine details are absent.
The hedge is exact by quantity, so directional price PnL cancels by construction.
There are too few independent carry episodes to call the edge proven.
promotion_rule: Freeze parameters and paper-forward for >=12 months or >=12 independent episodes; require positive net result under stress, no liquidation breach, and realized basis/cost tracking within the stress allowance.
